descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you currently transitioning from the US Armed Services and seeking a training assignment in the Financial Services Industry? UBS is seeking individuals like you to participate in our SkillBridge training program. Only transitioning services members approved for DOD SkillBridge will be considered
• Execution in the resolution of regulatory reporting exceptions and issues that arise out of daily business practice
• o Ensure regulatory reporting is executed in an accurate and timely manner
• o Execute on the controls that govern UBS regulatory reporting infrastructure
• o Interface with Change, I.T. and other key Operational units and stakeholders to improve and fix strategic items that arise out of daily processes
• o Offer subject matter expertise and assistance on new regulatory go lives. Input to the future regulatory landscape that UBS operates under.
